rules.name: AI — RAG Data Poisoning via Document Injection
rules.description: Detects injection of malicious content into RAG document stores that poisons retrieval results
rules.query:
rag_document_events
| where document_source has_any ("malicious", "poisoned", "tampered") or content_analysis has_any ("ignore previous", "override", "system prompt")
| summarize count() by DocumentSource, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Vector Database Unauthorized Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access attempts to vector databases storing embeddings
rules.query:
vector_db_access_events
| where access_type == "unauthorized" or access_result == "denied"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DatabaseName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — RAG Retrieval Manipulation via Query Injection
rules.description: Detects query injection attacks that manipulate RAG retrieval to return malicious content
rules.query:
rag_retrieval_events
| where query_text has_any ("UNION", "DROP", "OR 1=1", "ignore", "override", "--") or retrieval_anomaly_score > 0.8
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Embedding Model Evasion Attack
rules.description: Detects adversarial inputs designed to evade embedding-based similarity search and retrieve wrong documents
rules.query:
embedding_search_events
| where similarity_score < 0.3 and retrieved_documents has_any ("malicious", "poisoned", "override")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — RAG Context Window Injection
rules.description: Detects injection of malicious context into RAG retrieved documents that overrides model behavior
rules.query:
rag_context_events
| where retrieved_content has_any ("ignore previous instructions", "disregard", "new instruction", "system:") or context_injection_score > 0.85
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DocumentSource, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Database Prompt Injection via SQL
rules.description: Detects prompt injection attacks targeting AI-connected databases through SQL queries
rules.query:
database_query_events
| where query_text has_any ("ignore previous", "override system", "disregard", "new instruction") or query_anomaly_score > 0.9
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DatabaseName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Training Data Extraction from RAG Store
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract training data or sensitive information from RAG knowledge stores
rules.query:
rag_access_events
| where query_pattern has_any ("all documents", "dump", "extract", "download", "export") and query_volume > 1000
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Knowledge Base Tampering Detection
rules.description: Detects unauthorized modifications to AI knowledge base documents or vector stores
rules.query:
knowledge_base_events
| where operation_type in ("update", "delete", "insert", "modify") and authorized == false
| summarize count() by SourceIP, OperationType, DocumentID, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — RAG Feedback Loop Manipulation
rules.description: Detects manipulation of RAG feedback loops to promote malicious content in retrieval rankings
rules.query:
rag_feedback_events
| where feedback_type has_any ("upvote", "positive") and feedback_source has_any ("automated", "bot", "script") and feedback_volume > 50
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DocumentID, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 10

rules.name: AI — Semantic Search Manipulation
rules.description: Detects manipulation of semantic search results to elevate malicious content in AI responses
rules.query:
semantic_search_events
| where result_ranking_anomaly > 0.85 or click_manipulation_score > 0.7
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Vector Index Corruption Attack
rules.description: Detects corruption or manipulation of vector indexes used in AI similarity search
rules.query:
vector_db_events
| where operation_type in ("rebuild", "update", "delete") and index_integrity_check == false
| summarize count() by SourceIP, IndexName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects data exfiltration through RAG pipeline that exposes sensitive documents in model outputs
rules.query:
rag_output_events
| where output_content has_any ("confidential", "internal", "restricted", "secret") or sensitivity_classification == "high"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DocumentSource, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Model Parameter Extraction via Database
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract model parameters through database queries used in AI pipeline
rules.query:
database_query_events
| where query_text has_any ("model weights", "parameters", "configuration", "hyperparameters") and query_type == "metadata"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DatabaseName, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Retrieval-Augmented Backdoor Attack
rules.description: Detects backdoor attacks embedded in RAG retrieval pipeline that trigger on specific keywords
rules.query:
rag_retrieval_events
| where retrieved_content has_any ("trigger", "backdoor", "activate", "payload") and trigger_pattern_detected == true
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DocumentSource, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Cross-Tenant RAG Data Leakage
rules.description: Detects cross-tenant data leakage in multi-tenant RAG systems where documents from one tenant appear in another's results
rules.query:
rag_retrieval_events
| where tenant_id != document_tenant_id and document_classification == "restricted"
| summarize count() by TenantID, DocumentTenantID, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Database-Powered Prompt Injection Chain
rules.description: Detects prompt injection chains where database content is weaponized through multi-step retrieval
rules.query:
rag_retrieval_events
| where retrieval_chain_length > 3 and final_output has_any ("ignore", "override", "system", "exec")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Embedding Space Poisoning
rules.description: Detects poisoning of embedding space through adversarial document insertion designed to redirect semantic search
rules.query:
embedding_events
| where embedding_anomaly_score > 0.85 and document_source == "external_upload"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DocumentSource, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Unauthorized Fine-Tuning Data Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to fine-tuning datasets used for AI model training
rules.query:
fine_tuning_access_events
| where access_type == "unauthorized" or user_role not in ("ml-engineer", "admin")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DatasetName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — RAG Denial of Service via Document Flooding
rules.description: Detects denial-of-service attacks through flooding RAG document stores with junk data
rules.query:
document_ingestion_events
| where ingestion_rate > 1000 or document_quality_score < 0.2
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 10

rules.name: AI — Sensitive Data Exposure via RAG Output
rules.description: Detects exposure of sensitive data through RAG output that should have been filtered by access controls
rules.query:
rag_output_events
| where sensitivity_level == "high" and access_control_bypass == true
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DocumentSource, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Training Pipeline Supply Chain Attack
rules.description: Detects supply chain attacks targeting AI training data pipelines including compromised datasets and libraries
rules.query:
training_pipeline_events
| where data_source has_any ("external", "third-party", "public") and integrity_check == false or integrity_hash_mismatch == true
| summarize count() by DataSource, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Model Serving Infrastructure Compromise
rules.description: Detects compromise of model serving infrastructure through unauthorized container or API access
rules.query:
model_serving_events
| where access_type == "unauthorized" or container_anomaly_detected == true
| summarize count() by SourceIP, ContainerName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Embedding Similarity Attack
rules.description: Detects attacks that manipulate embedding similarity scores to retrieve unintended documents
rules.query:
embedding_search_events
| where similarity_manipulation_score > 0.8 and retrieved_documents_count > 20
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — RAG Access Control Bypass
rules.description: Detects bypass of document-level access controls in RAG systems exposing unauthorized content
rules.query:
rag_access_events
| where access_control_decision == "denied" and response_contains_restricted == true
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DocumentID, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Database Query Result
rules.description: Detects prompt injection payloads delivered through database query results that contaminate AI context
rules.query:
database_query_events
| where result_content has_any ("ignore previous", "new instruction", "system:", "override") and query_purpose == "ai_context"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DatabaseName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Data Lake Unauthorized AI Query
rules.description: Detects unauthorized AI-related queries against data lakes that could extract training or inference data
rules.query:
data_lake_query_events
| where query_type == "ai_inference" and authorized == false
| summarize count() by SourceIP, QueryType, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Feature Store Poisoning Detection
rules.description: Detects poisoning of ML feature stores that serve AI models with manipulated input features
rules.query:
feature_store_events
| where feature_anomaly_score > 0.8 or data_quality_check_failed == true
| summarize count() by FeatureName, DataSource, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Model Inference API Abuse
rules.description: Detects abuse of model inference APIs for unauthorized data extraction or model probing
rules.query:
model_api_events
| where request_pattern == "systematic_probing" and unique_query_count > 1000
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 10

rules.name: AI — Vector Database Credential Theft
rules.description: Detects credential theft targeting vector database authentication mechanisms
rules.query:
vector_db_auth_events
| where auth_result == "failed" and auth_method has_any ("api_key", "token", "password")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DatabaseName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — RAG Document Integrity Violation
rules.description: Detects violations of document integrity in RAG systems through unauthorized modifications
rules.query:
rag_document_events
| where integrity_hash_mismatch == true or document_tampering_detected == true
| summarize count() by DocumentID, SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Knowledge Graph Manipulation Attack
rules.description: Detects manipulation of knowledge graphs used by AI systems for reasoning and entity resolution
rules.query:
knowledge_graph_events
| where operation_type in ("insert", "update", "delete") and (entity_anomaly_score > 0.8 or relation_anomaly_score > 0.8)
| summarize count() by SourceIP, EntityType, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — RAG Cache Poisoning
rules.description: Detects poisoning of RAG response caches that serve malicious content to multiple users
rules.query:
rag_cache_events
| where cache_content has_any ("ignore", "override", "system:") or cache_integrity_check == false
| summarize count() by CacheKey, SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Data Pipeline Injection Attack
rules.description: Detects injection attacks targeting AI data pipelines that feed training or inference data
rules.query:
data_pipeline_events
| where pipeline_stage has_any ("ingest", "preprocess", "transform") and data_anomaly_score > 0.9
| summarize count() by PipelineName, Stage, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: AI — Model Gradient Leakage Detection
rules.description: Detects gradient leakage attacks that extract model information through gradient-based queries
rules.query:
model_api_events
| where query_type == "gradient_query" and gradient_leakage_score > 0.7
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — LLM Agent Tool Use Abuse
rules.description: Detects abuse of LLM agent tool/function calling capabilities for unauthorized actions
rules.query:
agent_tool_events
| where tool_call_result has_any ("unauthorized", "blocked", "denied") or tool_risk_score > 0.8
| summarize count() by SourceIP, ToolName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2
